segments.sn4.17:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.sn4.17:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ upādāya bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
segments.sn4.17:1.3: Te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
segments.sn4.17:2.2: “ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ upādāya bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sappahaṃseti.
segments.sn4.17:2.3: Te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
segments.sn4.17:2.4: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā”ti.
segments.sn4.17:2.5: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravaṃ saddamakāsi, apissudaṃ pathavī maññe undrīyati [udrīyati (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī) u + dara + ya + ti = udrīyati]. Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn4.17:2.7: Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn4.17:2.9: Māro eso pāpimā tumhākaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgato”ti.
segments.sn4.17:2.10: Atha kho bhagavā “māro ayaṃ pāpimā” iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.17:3.1: “Rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phassā dhammā ca kevalā;
segments.sn4.17:3.3: Etaṃ lokāmisaṃ ghoraṃ, ettha loko vimucchito.
segments.sn4.17:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā … pe … tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Pathavī maññe undrīyatīti ayaṃ mahāpathavī paṭapaṭasaddaṃ kurumānā viya ahosi.
Ettha loko vimucchitoti etesu chasu ārammaṇesu loko adhimucchito.
Sañjāyati etasmāti sañjāti, so eva sampayuttadhammo samosarati etthāti samosaraṇaṃ, so eva attho, tena sañjātisamosaraṇaṭṭhena.
Bhayabheravaṃ saddanti bhāyati etasmāti bhayaṃ, tadeva yassa kassaci bheravāvahattā bheravaṃ, devādisaddanti attho.
